name: Mexican-Style Tofu Scramble with Bell Pepper, Green Onion & Tortillas
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Place in a small bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve the remainder for serving.)
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, cilantro, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Crumble tofu into large pieces with your fingers and add to the skillet along with salt and pepper. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Warm tortillas in another skillet or the microwave (optional).
Divide tofu scramble and tortillas between plates; sprinkle tofu with reserved cilantro. Serve with hot sauce on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
